```plato

    //==
    // # Cox-de Boor basis functions

    // A ratio that reads as zero when its denominator vanishes. Every repeated
    // knot produces a 0/0 in the recurrence, and the convention that those terms
    // are zero is what makes repeated knots mean "reduced continuity" rather than
    // "undefined".
    KnotRatio(numerator: Number, denominator: Number): Number
        => denominator == 0.0 ? 0.0 : numerator / denominator;
```
